title: Plug-in trajectory-tube audit of main Proposition 2

quantities.beta_median: median over depths and audited trajectories of the plug-in factor beta_l
quantities.beta_p95: 95th percentile over depths and audited trajectories of beta_l
quantities.m_eps_op: median over depths of the plug-in operator term M_l eps_l^op
quantities.reference_term: median over depths of the plug-in reference term R_l e_l^ref
quantities.tube_coverage: fraction of audited trajectories whose realized state error stays inside the tube at every depth
quantities.mode_stable_coverage: fraction of audited trajectories whose realized and predicted runs keep the same action, recovery mode and last-safe index at every depth (the fixed-mode condition of Proposition 2)
quantities.final_bound_nats: product-sum tube bound of Proposition 2 at the final depth with the empirical per-depth constants, sqrt(2) ||W_head||_2 e_L (cm_theory.stability.unrolled_bound and logit_loss_bound; nats)
quantities.observed_error_median_nats: median over audited D_explore trajectories of |predicted minus realized loss| at the final depth (nats)
quantities.observed_error_p95_nats: 95th percentile of the same observed loss error (nats)

notes: Computed from the exploration trajectories and the frozen consequence models of the run; the per-depth constants beta_l, M_l, eps_l^op, R_l and e_l^ref are kept as raw arrays. The runtime records none of them. The violation rate of Table S22 is 1 - mode_stable_coverage (convention C22). main_paper.py reads final_bound_nats and the two observed-error quantities of the same rows.
